subject.title: Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should OpenClaw add `openclaw-even-g2-node` as a trusted setup-code bootstrap identity for matching Even Hub glasses node metadata?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and proof-backed, but it changes which external client identity may receive silent setup-code approval and bounded operator credentials, which is a Gateway security and product boundary.

options.title: Approve This Identity Slice
options.body: Land the minimal Gateway bootstrap identity after the merge conflict is resolved and required checks are green.

options.title: Rename Before Merge
options.body: Ask for a generation-neutral Even Hub wire id while keeping the same metadata gate and spoof coverage.

options.title: Pause Behind Broader Direction
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until the linked Even G2 integration issue settles app placement and supported Gateway capability scope.
